data.gender_notes: Brunon is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word ‘brunus’, meaning ‘brown’ or ‘dark’. The name Brunon has a strong, robust connotation due to its origin as a descriptive name for someone with brown hair or complexion. The name Brunon carries the meaning “Strong, brown one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Brunon usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brown one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brunon total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
